calls.statement:
SELECT status,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS n_distinct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helsinki_day,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_day
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-29' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
    AND status <> 'cancelled'
), t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o)
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o) AS orders,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM o) AS distinct_orders,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) AS test_orders,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line)) AS no_lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE login_state='guest') AS guests,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE status='processing') AS processing
